label.name: Name
label.table: Tag Table (msg.payload.tags merges by ID/address; missing values use defaults)

hint.deviceId: Enter when used independently; the output deviceId will use this value
hint.csv: First row contains column names; one tag per following row. Write values use msg.payload.tags[].value first, then the default-value column.
hint.static: Static: configured tags and defaults; any message triggers a write | Dynamic: msg.payload.tags merges by ID/address
hint.writeValue: Write value: msg.payload.tags[].value takes priority, otherwise use table default; skip if neither exists
hint.bool: BOOL / bit-device addresses use RMW (read-modify-write); non-BOOL word devices use direct batch writes

table.name: Name
table.byteOrderTitle: Byte order: swap high/low bytes within a 16-bit word
table.wordOrderTitle: Word order: high/low word order for 32/64-bit values
table.bitTitle: Bit offset: bit position within a word for BOOL (0–15)
table.defaultValueTitle: Static default: used when msg does not provide value; leave blank to require msg.value
